summary.service_description: An office visit at Sound Orthopedics on November 12, 2025.
summary.plain_language_summary: Your claim for an office visit was partly paid by your plan. The total billed was $285.00, but the plan only allowed $165.00 for this service.
summary.what_happened: The plan paid $132.00 of the allowed amount, and you are responsible for the remaining $33.00.
summary.why_adjusted: The provider billed more than what the plan allows for this service, which is why the payment was adjusted. The plan only pays based on the allowed amount, and since this was an in-network visit, you are not responsible for the difference between the billed and allowed amounts. You owe a copayment based on the allowed amount.
next_steps: Review your Explanation of Benefits (EOB) for details on the payment.
If you receive a bill from the provider for more than $33.00, contact them to clarify your responsibility.
If you have questions, call Pacific HMO Member Services at 1-800-555-0142 and have your claim number ready.
summary.appeal_rights_summary: If you disagree with this decision, you have the right to appeal. You must file your appeal within 60 days from EOB date. To start an appeal or ask questions, call Pacific HMO Member Services at 1-800-555-0142.
